articles.title: 俄羅斯莫斯科餐廳爆炸3死21傷　當局稱是自製炸彈襲擊
articles.summary: 俄羅斯莫斯科一間餐廳有炸彈爆炸，死咗3個人，仲有21個人受傷。

levels.text: 俄羅斯莫斯科市中心有一間餐廳發生爆炸，死咗3個人，仲有21個人受傷。當局話係自製炸彈引起。星期六晚，有個女人想帶住炸彈入餐廳，畀餐廳保安攔住，跟住炸彈就爆咗，個女人同保安即場死咗，仲有一個客人都死埋。
levels.text_en: A restaurant in central Moscow, Russia had an explosion. 3 people died and 21 were injured. Authorities say it was caused by a homemade bomb. On Saturday night, a woman wanted to bring a bomb into the restaurant but was stopped by the restaurant's security. Then the bomb exploded. The woman and the security guard died on the spot, and one customer also died.

levels.text: 俄羅斯國家反恐委員會話，莫斯科市中心一間餐廳發生嘅爆炸，係由自製炸彈引起，事件死咗3個人、21個人受傷。爆炸喺當地時間星期六晚發生。報道話，有個女人想帶住自製炸彈闖入餐廳，畀餐廳保安攔住，跟住炸彈就啟動爆炸，嗰個女人同保安即場死咗，仲有一個客人都死埋。發生爆炸嘅餐廳，喺俄羅斯一座出名嘅地標大樓——庫德林廣場大樓。
levels.text_en: Russia's National Anti-Terrorism Committee said the explosion at a restaurant in central Moscow was caused by a homemade bomb; the incident killed 3 people and injured 21. The explosion happened on Saturday night local time. Reports say a woman wanted to force her way into the restaurant carrying a homemade bomb but was stopped by the restaurant's security. Then the bomb was activated and exploded. The woman and the security guard died on the spot, and one customer also died. The restaurant where the explosion happened is in a famous Russian landmark building — the Kudrin Square building.

levels.text: 俄羅斯國家反恐委員會表示，莫斯科市中心一間餐廳發生嘅爆炸，係由自製爆炸裝置引起，事件造成3人死亡、21人受傷。爆炸喺當地時間星期六晚發生。報道話，有一名女子企圖攜帶自製爆炸裝置闖入餐廳，畀餐廳保安阻攔，隨後爆炸裝置啟動，嗰名女子同保安當場死亡，事故仲造成一名顧客死亡。據了解，發生爆炸嘅餐廳位於俄羅斯著名地標建築——庫德林廣場大樓。
levels.text_en: Russia's National Anti-Terrorism Committee stated that the explosion at a restaurant in central Moscow was caused by a homemade explosive device; the incident caused 3 deaths and 21 injuries. The explosion happened on Saturday night local time. Reports say a woman attempted to force her way into the restaurant carrying a homemade explosive device but was stopped by the restaurant's security. Subsequently the explosive device was activated, and the woman and the security guard died on the spot; the incident also caused the death of one customer. It is understood that the restaurant where the explosion happened is located in a famous Russian landmark building — the Kudrin Square building.

levels.text: 俄羅斯莫斯科市中心一間餐廳發生爆炸，造成3人死亡、21人受傷。當局表示，爆炸由自製炸彈引起。事件在當地時間星期六晚發生。據報道，一名女子想帶自製炸彈進入餐廳，被餐廳保安阻止。之後炸彈啟動爆炸，該名女子和保安當場死亡，另有一名顧客死亡。發生爆炸的餐廳位於俄羅斯著名地標庫德林廣場大樓。
levels.text_en: An explosion happened at a restaurant in central Moscow, Russia, causing 3 deaths and 21 injuries. Authorities said the explosion was caused by a homemade bomb. The incident happened on Saturday night local time. According to reports, a woman wanted to enter the restaurant carrying a homemade bomb but was stopped by the restaurant's security. Afterwards the bomb was activated and exploded, and the woman and the security guard died on the spot, with one more customer dying. The restaurant where the explosion happened is located in the famous Russian landmark, the Kudrin Square building.

levels.text: 俄羅斯國家反恐委員會表示，莫斯科市中心一間餐廳發生的爆炸是由自製爆炸裝置引起，事件造成3人死亡、21人受傷。 爆炸在當地時間星期六晚發生，報道說，一名女子企圖攜帶自製爆炸裝置闖入餐廳，被餐廳保安阻攔，隨後爆炸裝置啟動，該名女子和保安當場死亡。事故還造成一名顧客死亡。 據了解，發生爆炸的餐廳位於俄羅斯著名地標建築庫德林廣場大樓。 編輯︰張萬燕
levels.text_en: Russia's National Anti-Terrorism Committee stated that the explosion at a restaurant in central Moscow was caused by a homemade explosive device; the incident caused 3 deaths and 21 injuries. The explosion happened on Saturday night local time. Reports say a woman attempted to force her way into the restaurant carrying a homemade explosive device but was stopped by the restaurant's security. Subsequently the explosive device was activated, and the woman and the security guard died on the spot. The incident also caused the death of one customer. It is understood that the restaurant where the explosion happened is located in the famous Russian landmark building, the Kudrin Square building. Editor: Cheung Man-yin

articles.summary_en: An explosion at a restaurant in central Moscow, Russia, killed 3 people and injured 21. Russian authorities say it was caused by a homemade bomb, when a woman tried to enter with the device and was stopped by security.

articles.title: 國米互射十二碼贏曼城　現場觀賞球星獻技球迷感興奮
articles.summary: 國米喺啟德體育園互射十二碼贏咗曼城，好多球迷入場睇球星，都覺得好興奮。

levels.text: 喺啟德體育園有場好大嘅足球賽，國米互射十二碼3:1贏咗曼城。呢場波吸引咗超過4萬2千個球迷入場睇。好多球迷都話，現場氣氛好好，場波好刺激，可以喺香港睇到自己支持嘅球星踢波真係好難得，佢哋覺得好興奮。
levels.text_en: There was a big football match at Kai Tak Sports Park, where Inter Milan beat Manchester City 3:1 on penalties. The match drew over 42,000 fans. Many fans said the atmosphere on-site was great and the match was exciting; being able to watch the football stars they support play in Hong Kong is truly rare, and they felt very excited.

levels.text: 喺啟德體育園舉行嘅「香港足球盛會」，意甲班霸國際米蘭互射十二碼3:1擊敗英超勁旅曼城。呢場波吸引咗超過4萬2千名球迷入場，仲有好幾位官員都有現場觀戰。唔少球迷都話，現場氣氛好好，比賽好刺激，可以喺香港睇到自己支持嘅球星踢波係好難得嘅事，感到非常興奮。兩隊都派咗好多球星正選上陣，開波之後互有攻守，法定時間90分鐘都分唔出勝負，最後要互射十二碼決勝。
levels.text_en: At the "Hong Kong Football Fiesta" held at Kai Tak Sports Park, Italian Serie A champions Inter Milan beat English Premier League powerhouse Manchester City 3:1 on penalties. The match drew over 42,000 fans, and several officials also watched on-site. Many fans said the atmosphere was great and the match was exciting; being able to watch the stars they support play in Hong Kong is a rare thing, and they felt very excited. Both teams fielded many stars in their starting lineups, and after kickoff they traded attack and defence; the 90 minutes of regulation time produced no winner, so it was ultimately decided by a penalty shootout.

levels.text: 喺啟德體育園舉行嘅「香港足球盛會」，意甲班霸國際米蘭互射十二碼3:1擊敗英超勁旅曼城。賽事吸引超過4萬2千名球迷入場，財政司副司長黃偉綸、商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺、文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩等官員都有現場觀戰。唔少球迷都話，現場氣氛好好，比賽相當刺激，可以喺香港睇到支持嘅球星獻技係非常難得嘅事，感到非常興奮。呢場季前熱身賽，兩隊都派咗多名球星正選上陣。曼城由梅巴馬先開紀錄，但幾分鐘後國米就憑柏華特追平，半場踢成1:1。換邊後曼城積極搶攻，可惜多次機會都射唔入，90分鐘分唔出勝負，最終互射十二碼被國米擊敗。
levels.text_en: At the "Hong Kong Football Fiesta" held at Kai Tak Sports Park, Italian Serie A champions Inter Milan beat English Premier League powerhouse Manchester City 3:1 on penalties. The match drew over 42,000 fans, and officials including Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong, Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau, and Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law watched on-site. Many fans said the atmosphere was great and the match was quite exciting; being able to watch the stars they support show their skills in Hong Kong is a very rare thing, and they felt very excited. In this pre-season warm-up match, both teams fielded many stars in their starting lineups. Manchester City opened the scoring through Mbeumo, but a few minutes later Inter equalized through Palacios, making it 1:1 at half-time. After the change of ends Manchester City attacked aggressively, but unfortunately failed to convert many chances; the 90 minutes produced no winner, and in the end they were beaten by Inter on penalties.

levels.text: 「香港足球盛會」喺啟德體育園舉行。意甲球隊國際米蘭互射十二碼3:1擊敗英超球隊曼城。賽事吸引超過4萬2千名球迷入場。財政司副司長黃偉綸、商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺、文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩等官員都有到場觀看。不少球迷都話現場氣氛好好，比賽好刺激，能夠喺香港睇到支持嘅球星踢波好難得，感到非常興奮。呢場是季前熱身賽，兩隊都派出多名球星上陣。曼城先入一球，之後國米追平，半場1:1。換邊後曼城多次搶攻都射唔入，90分鐘分唔出勝負。最終互射十二碼，曼城1:3不敵國米。
levels.text_en: The "Hong Kong Football Fiesta" was held at Kai Tak Sports Park. Italian side Inter Milan beat English side Manchester City 3:1 on penalties. The match drew over 42,000 fans. Officials including Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong, Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau, and Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law attended to watch. Many fans said the atmosphere on-site was great and the match was exciting; being able to watch the stars they support play in Hong Kong is rare, and they felt very excited. This was a pre-season warm-up match, and both teams fielded many stars. Manchester City scored first, then Inter equalized, 1:1 at half-time. After the change of ends Manchester City attacked repeatedly but failed to score; the 90 minutes produced no winner. In the end, on penalties, Manchester City lost 1:3 to Inter.

levels.text: 在啟德體育園舉行的「香港足球盛會」，意甲班霸國際米蘭互射十二碼3:1擊敗英超勁旅曼城。 賽事吸引超過4萬2千名球迷入場，財政司副司長黃偉綸、商務及經濟發展局局長丘應樺、文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩等官員都有現場觀戰。 不少球迷都表示，現場氣氛很好，比賽相當刺激，能夠看到支持的球星在香港獻技是非常難得的事，感到非常興奮。 兩隊在這場季前熱身賽都派出多名球星正選上陣，包括曼城的科頓、施曼尤、當拿隆馬，以及國米的巴列拿、迪馬高等。 雙方開賽「快打快」、互有攻守。曼城由梅巴馬先開紀錄，但幾分鐘後國米就憑柏華特追平，半場踢成1:1。 換邊後，曼城壓著國米積極搶攻，但多次機會無法化成入球，雙方在法定時間90分鐘未能分出勝負。 曼城在新任領隊馬列斯卡首場執教的賽事，互射十二碼首3輪都宴客，最終1:3 不敵國米。
levels.text_en: At the "Hong Kong Football Fiesta" held at Kai Tak Sports Park, Italian Serie A champions Inter Milan beat English Premier League powerhouse Manchester City 3:1 on penalties. The match drew over 42,000 fans, and officials including Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong, Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau, and Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law watched on-site. Many fans said the atmosphere was great and the match was quite exciting; being able to see the stars they support show their skills in Hong Kong is a very rare thing, and they felt very excited. In this pre-season warm-up match both teams fielded many stars in their starting lineups, including Manchester City's Gvardiol, Savinho, and Donnarumma, as well as Inter's Barella and De Marco. The two sides played a fast-paced game from kickoff, trading attack and defence. Manchester City opened the scoring through Mbeumo, but a few minutes later Inter equalized through Palacios, making it 1:1 at half-time. After the change of ends, Manchester City pressed Inter and attacked aggressively, but repeatedly failed to convert their chances into goals, and the two sides could not be separated in the 90 minutes of regulation time. In this first match under new manager Maresca, Manchester City missed their first three penalties in the shootout and were ultimately beaten 1:3 by Inter.

articles.summary_en: A pre-season friendly football match ("Hong Kong Football Fiesta") was held at Kai Tak Sports Park in Hong Kong, where Italian side Inter Milan beat English side Manchester City on penalties.
